text:
Ava (Marketing): Hey team — draft of the product launch blog post is up in the doc: https://docs.google.com/example. Focus is: Redwood Optimize + benchmark narrative + a small code example showing embeddings and how customers can route leads. I pushed the draft to the 'final-pass' section. Need legal + sales signoff by EOD Wed so we can schedule publish Thu morning.

Diego (Content): Thanks — I'll paste the short embedding example we should show in the post so customers can quickly copy it. Keeping it minimal.

Diego (Content): ```bash
# embeddings example (curl)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"model":"open-embedding-mini","input":"Summarize Redwood Optimize benefits"}'
```

Diego (Content): And a tiny JSON response snippet to make the sample concrete: ```json
{"embedding":[0.012,-0.034,0.087,...],"model":"open-embedding-mini","usage":{"input_tokens":6}}
```

Nina (Legal): Quick pass: overall OK. Two copy asks: (1) swap the phrase "5x cheaper" — we need substantiation or change to "significantly lower per-token cost"; (2) remove the sentence implying SLA applies to dedicated customers only — that's fine but reword to avoid promise for hosted without a dedicated contract. I can approve after those edits.

Ava (Marketing): Good catches, Nina. I'll tweak the cost claim to "dramatically lower per-token cost with batching and caching" and clarify SLA language to mention "where contracted".

Sam (Sales): On CTAs: need a clear path for inbound lead routing. Suggest 2 CTAs in the post: "Request a demo" (for enterprise/Dedicated workflows) -> HubSpot form A; "Try the Hosted API" -> signup funnel with free credits (utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch). Also a webinar CTA: "See Optimize in action" -> registrants should tag as MQL if company_size > 50. Can we add the simple mapping?

Ava (Marketing): Added mapping in the doc and pasted below:
- CTA: Request a demo -> HubSpot form ID: hb-102 (assign to AE queue: enterprise)
- CTA: Try Hosted API -> /signup with utm params `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch` (assign to growth SDR flow)
- CTA: Webinar signup -> Eventbrite link + webhook -> HubSpot list "Optimize Webinar" (auto-add tag: webinar_reg)

Sam (Sales): Perfect. For the webinar tagging rule, please add a note to the ops playbook: if registrant.company_size > 50 AND role in ["Eng","Product","ML"], mark as high-priority and create task for AE.

Ava (Marketing): Will do.

Diego (Content): Also added a short benchmark blurb and a compact figure caption: "Latency and per-token cost measured on public open models with batching and quantization; customer workloads will vary." Keeps claims conservative.

Nina (Legal): That's acceptable. Minor nit: remove the word "public" from the caption (can be misread). Otherwise ok from legal side.

OpsBot: Reminder: marketing-posts channel scheduled publish job set for 2024-08-15T09:00Z once the file is uploaded to the CMS. If any change after 2024-08-14T16:00Z, ping @ops.

Ava (Marketing): Thanks OpsBot — note the final copy lock is Wed 16:00 PT. If we get signoff earlier we can move the publish earlier.

Sam (Sales): I'll review the HubSpot form and pipeline mapping now. ETA 2 hours.

Diego (Content): Final pass done — removed the stronger numeric claim, swapped caption wording per Nina, and added the embedding code block inline. Pushed changes to the doc and left comments where I changed the CTAs.

Ava (Marketing): Awesome. Marking this thread as ready for final signoff. Nina/Sam, can you drop a quick :thumbsup: in the thread when approved?

Nina (Legal): :thumbsup: approved (subject to the CMS copy being identical to the doc).

Sam (Sales): :thumbsup: approved — I'll follow up with the AE queue mapping after I finish HubSpot check.

Ava (Marketing): Fantastic — thanks everyone. Closing the loop here, will update the CMS and schedule the publish.
